findings.reason: Verified that MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now a bare `pass` subclass of StatefulDetectorHandler, so it leaves four abstract members unimplemented while still registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler; instantiating it raises TypeError, but nothing calls process_detectors in production yet, so the defect is real but latent.

Confirmed that IssueOccurrence.__eq__ compares only `id`, that the mock always uses a constant id, and that event_data ignores group_key and value, so the occurrence assertions pass even though the expected occurrences use the wrong keys and values ('val1' vs 'group_key', 6 vs 10/100/8); the new hook wiring is effectively untested.
The evaluate docstring at line 230 still says it returns a list while the method now returns a dict; correct but docs-only.
